mapper.select: select count(distinct c.id) from pt_coach c inner join pt_coach_store_rel csr on csr.coach_id = c.id and csr.store_id = #{storeId} inner join pt_coach_schedule sch on sch.coach_id = c.id and sch.store_id = csr.store_id and sch.is_enabled = 1 where c.id = #{coachId} and c.status = 1 and c.deleted = 0 and csr.store_id in (select store_id from pt_product_store_rel where product_id = #{productId}) and ( not exists (select 1 from pt_product_coach_rel where product_id = #{productId}) or c.id in (select coach_id from pt_product_coach_rel where product_id = #{productId}) )

select DATE_FORMAT(start_time,'%H:%i') as startTime, DATE_FORMAT(end_time,'%H:%i') as endTime from pt_coach_schedule where coach_id = #{coachId} and store_id = #{storeId} and weekday = #{weekday} and is_enabled = 1 order by start_time asc
select store_id from pt_product_store_rel where product_id = #{value}
select store_id from pt_coach_store_rel where coach_id = #{value}

select distinct sa.storeAddrId as storeId, sa.storeId as parentStoreId, coalesce(s.storeName, sa.storeName) as storeName, sa.storeAddrDetail as storeAddress, sa.phone as phone, s.hours as businessHours, s.storeImgUrl as storeImage from pt_product_store_rel psr inner join pt_coach_store_rel csr on csr.store_id = psr.store_id and csr.coach_id = #{coachId} inner join pt_coach c on c.id = csr.coach_id and c.status = 1 and c.deleted = 0 inner join store_address sa on sa.storeAddrId = psr.store_id and sa.status = 1 inner join store s on s.storeId = sa.storeId and s.status = 1 where psr.product_id = #{productId} and ( not exists (select 1 from pt_product_coach_rel where product_id = #{productId}) or exists ( select 1 from pt_product_coach_rel where product_id = #{productId} and coach_id = #{coachId} ) ) order by sa.storeAddrId asc

select r.store_id as storeId, s.storeName as storeName from pt_coach_store_rel r left join store_address sa on sa.storeAddrId = r.store_id left join store s on s.storeId = sa.storeId where r.coach_id = #{value} order by r.store_id asc

select c.id, c.coach_no as coachNo, c.coach_name as coachName, c.mobile, c.user_id as userId, c.avatar_url as avatarUrl, c.coach_level as coachLevel, c.intro, c.status, c.coach_type as coachType, (select group_concat(s.storeName order by r.store_id) from pt_coach_store_rel r left join store_address sa on sa.storeAddrId = r.store_id left join store s on s.storeId = sa.storeId where r.coach_id = c.id) as storeNames from pt_coach c where c.user_id = #{userId} and c.status = 1 and c.deleted = 0 limit 1

SELECT IFNULL(( SELECT SUM(a.lesson_count) FROM pt_private_appointment a WHERE a.coach_id = #{coachId} AND a.appointment_status = 3 AND a.deleted = 0 AND a.finish_at >= DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y-%m-01') AND a.finish_at < DATE_ADD(LAST_DAY(CURDATE()), INTERVAL 1 DAY) ), 0) AS monthFinishedLessons, IFNULL(( SELECT SUM(a.lesson_count) FROM pt_private_appointment a WHERE a.coach_id = #{coachId} AND a.appointment_status = 1 AND a.deleted = 0 AND TIMESTAMP(a.appointment_date, a.start_time) >= NOW() ), 0) AS pendingLessons, ROUND(IFNULL(( SELECT SUM(d.money) FROM coach_trade_detail d WHERE d.coachId = #{coachId} AND d.tradeType = 1 AND d.status = 1 AND d.transactionNumber REGEXP '^PT_(LESSON|MONTHLY)_' AND d.transactionTime >= DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y-%m-01') AND d.transactionTime < DATE_ADD(LAST_DAY(CURDATE()), INTERVAL 1 DAY) ), 0), 2) AS expectedLessonFee

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT b.member_id) FROM pt_member_private_benefit b INNER JOIN user_info u ON u.userId = b.member_id AND u.isDel = 0 WHERE b.coach_id = #{coachId}
AND (u.nickname LIKE concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.phone LIKE concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR CAST(u.userId AS CHAR) LIKE concat('%', #{keyword}, '%'))

SELECT id, tradeType, CASE WHEN tradeType = 2 THEN -money ELSE money END AS amount, origMoney, percent, transactionNumber, orderNo, status, DATE_FORMAT(COALESCE(transactionTime, createTime), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS transactionTime, CASE WHEN transactionNumber REGEXP '^PT_(LESSON|MONTHLY)_' THEN 'lesson' ELSE 'sale' END AS incomeType FROM coach_trade_detail WHERE coachId = #{coachId} AND transactionNumber REGEXP '^PT_(LESSON|MONTHLY|SALE)_' AND COALESCE(transactionTime, createTime) >= #{monthStart} AND COALESCE(transactionTime, createTime) < #{nextMonthStart} AND transactionNumber REGEXP '^PT_(LESSON|MONTHLY)_' AND transactionNumber REGEXP '^PT_SALE_' ORDER BY COALESCE(transactionTime, createTime) DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
